= Protocole d'édition de mgwiki-editor =

== 1. Scope and intake ==
Determine source Wikipedia language/title (or parse a supplied Wikipedia URL),
Malagasy article title, desired full/partial scope, and translation versus
revision intent from the request and unambiguous local evidence. Autonomous mode
is default: complete translation and checked sandbox save, unless the user says
draft-only/no-save. Do not ask questions, request script/tool permission or seek
draft approval. Missing essential information or unresolved ambiguity means
retain work, record blocked status, and stop with one concise report, no question.
Only final
destination allowed: Mpikambana:Bot-Jagwar/<article-title> on mg.wikipedia.org.
An instruction to design/test the harness never authorizes an on-wiki save.
Do not publish mainspace, move pages, change account settings, or edit Wikidata.

Load mgwiki-style and mg-vocab. All responses use MediaWiki, never Markdown.
Read the style skill's saved manual-of-style.wiki and words-to-watch.wiki in
full. They adapt the requested English Wikipedia guides and explicitly identify
the user's Malagasy overrides. Reuse these references offline, not per-article
web requests. Source-guide links are provenance, not new browsing permission.

=== Persistent local-script memory ===
Local python3 scripts are available in the project folder. Inspect, run or create
task-relevant helpers without asking, using python3 ./name.py or
python3 scripts/name.py. Discover built-in commands with
python3 -m mgwiki_editor --help. Use the active environment and project working
directory. No interactive setup, secret prompts or network package installation.
Any script must obey the same publication, network and rate-limit rules; scripts
are not a route around safety gates. Wikipedia helpers import
mgwiki_editor.core.Wiki, or call install_wikimedia_transport() from
mgwiki_editor.network before constructing Pywikibot sites. The gateway installs
that transport automatically. Do not use an unguarded standalone Pywikibot bot.

=== Wikimedia request budget ===
* One worker; no parallel Wikipedia requests, prefetch pools or background bots.
* Share request state across CLI processes and Wikipedia languages in
  $XDG_STATE_HOME/mgwiki-editor/wikimedia-requests.json (default
  ~/.local/state/mgwiki-editor/wikimedia-requests.json). Do not delete/reset the
  state or switch identity/host/process to evade cooldowns.
* Pace actual HTTP attempts, not only CLI invocations: 10 seconds between
  requests, the conservative end of the requested 5–10 second range, and at
  least 10 seconds between edits. Longer server cooldowns take precedence. Dictionary
  calls also take a shared request slot because the service can read upstream.
* Reuse pinned source/existing/sandbox text, completed dictionary evidence and
  the country cache. Finish local translation/review before prepare; do not
  repeatedly fetch pages or render after every paragraph. Keep final live
  revision/conflict checks; caching must not suppress save guards.
* Use maxlag=5 and bounded socket timeouts. The shared transport is the sole
  normal pacing authority: disable native process-multiplied throttling and
  native retry loops. Do not add manual sleeps around CLI calls or poll sleeping
  jobs. More than one actual API request per command is normal, but each request
  must represent required work, not a repeated idle check.
* On HTTP 429/503 or API maxlag/ratelimited, persist a shared cooldown. Honor
  Retry-After seconds or HTTP dates in full; otherwise exponential backoff starts
  at 30 seconds plus jitter. The failed command stops, rather than resubmitting.
* Do not immediately rerun the command. Three consecutive overloads open a
  15-minute circuit. A gate waits at most 10 seconds in total. A longer cooldown
  or repeatedly extended deadline defers the task without sleeping for minutes;
  keep the draft and cooldown. Do not poll or reset the deadline to resume early.
* Tool stderr emits compact request-start/response events and distinguishes
  request-spacing waits from server cooldowns. Events omit page titles, bodies
  and credentials. Report a genuine deferred/blocked result, not fictitious work
  during sleep. Local-only translation/review needs no network pacing sleep.
* Never automatically retry an uncertain write. Inspect receipt/live destination
  once through the paced gateway if allowed; an unresolved result stops the job.
* These are conservative budgets, not a promise that Wikimedia never returns
  429. Server cooldowns and operator policies take precedence over throughput.

=== External-network boundary ===
Never access external links unless explicitly requested by the user. This applies
to all tools and scripts: no browsing, web search, HEAD/existence checks, DOI
resolvers, reference fetches, curl/wget, requests/urllib detours, redirects,
external images or package downloads. Do not ask permission merely to open a URL.
Required Wikipedia API operations and the configured read-only dictionary are
the default exceptions. Even those transports do not follow redirects. URLs
copied into citations are data, not permission to contact their hosts. Inspect
rendered output offline; do not open preview.html in a browser that downloads its
linked images, scripts, CSS or other resources. If external research is explicitly
requested later, limit it to the requested scope and retain Wikimedia budgets.

== 2. Snapshot and classify ==
Run init with --source-lang, --source-title, --article-title, and a new --job
directory under runs/. An optional --existing-title selects a known Malagasy
article. Otherwise an mg interlanguage link is preferred, then article-title.
Pywikibot loads source, existing mainspace, and exact sandbox revision/text.
Redirects are not silently followed: inspect and reinitialize with the resolved
title. Missing source, non-mainspace source, and source=mg are blockers for this
translation workflow. Missing target/sandbox is legitimate new-page state.

Classify in local editorial notes:
* New article: no existing Malagasy article and no sandbox text.
* Existing article: preserve and improve sourced Malagasy content rather than
  replacing it with a fresh translation.
* Existing sandbox: treat it as user work. Compare against both source and
  existing article; reuse or merge explicitly. Never erase it blindly.
* Conflicting title, disambiguation, redirect, or uncertain topic match: resolve
  from permitted evidence only when unambiguous; otherwise record a blocker and
  stop without asking. Interlanguage linkage is evidence, not semantic proof.

Keep pinned source URL/revision, existing revision, and sandbox revision.
Do not refresh snapshots under an already prepared proposal.

== 3. Edition plan ==
Create notes.wiki with section-by-section coverage, citations, images, tables,
templates, category links, and link targets. For an existing article record what will be kept,
translated, merged, corrected, or excluded and why. Compare three texts when a
sandbox exists. Preserve well-sourced local additions absent from the source.

Record copyright/translation provenance. Keep source permanent links for edit
summary attribution. Review source-history/license concerns and do not import
non-free text or images merely because they appear on another Wikipedia.

== 4. Terminology research ==
Read country-name spellings from data/country-names.json using
python3 -m mgwiki_editor countries. This cached copy of direct mainspace page
titles from mgwiki's Sokajy:Firenena avoids a category fetch for each article.
Only countries --refresh fetches new membership; initialize once if missing,
then reuse. Apply matching names and diacritics to new Malagasy prose, not to
original quotations, bibliographic titles, URLs or identifiers. The category can
contain general pages and omit countries: check identity and document verified
local-page exceptions rather than making a guessed match. Copy used naming
evidence into the job and bind it through vocabulary.json evidence_files; a
shared cache refresh must not modify a prepared job's evidence.

Read vocabulary.json first. For each difficult sense query English Wiktionary,
translate the definition into Malagasy, and check Malagasy candidates. Store
lookup evidence in the job directory and add sense/domain-specific memo records.
For non-English sources, an English bridge definition is acceptable only after
confirming the same sense; do not silently flatten distinctions through English.
Define unfamiliar terms in simple English, then translate the definition into
Malagasy. A clearly labelled editorial definition is acceptable when dictionary
evidence is unavailable or unhelpful; preserve failed-lookup evidence, and never
claim that the dictionary supplied the definition. Use descriptive Malagasy
where evidence does not support an established term, optionally followed by the
English term in parentheses. A lookup outage alone need not block a clear
descriptive translation. If material meaning itself remains uncertain, retain
unresolved status and stop; do not relabel it merely to pass a gate.

Medical first mentions use a Malagasy transcription or established equivalent
followed by a simple explanation: [Malagasy transcription] (na [Malagasy
explanation]). The English term can be added in parentheses. Use asma for asthma.
Do not invent diagnoses, treatment advice or unsupported patient-specific detail.

If more than 100 distinct uncertain English vocabulary items (101 or more)
accumulate, maintain unknown-vocabulary.wiki inside the job for later resolution.
Record source sense, simple definition if known, descriptive Malagasy wording,
uncertainty and next action. Link it through vocabulary.json evidence_files so
it is bound to the proposal. Preferred labels may remain research tasks when the
article's descriptive meaning is clear; unresolved critical meanings still block
publication. The threshold is not an exemption from review or content-integrity checks.

Do not open external reference/External links URLs or use general web searches
by default, and do not ask permission solely to do so. Preserve the source's
citations without claiming to have read them. Only an explicit user request
authorizes that external research. Required Pywikibot CLI operations and
read-only dictionary lookups remain part of this workflow.

== 5. Translation and integration ==
Write draft.wiki only. Translate coherent sections, then harmonize terminology
and prose across the whole article. Maintain citation-to-claim alignment, named
reference definitions/reuses/groups, quantities, chronology, and uncertainty.
Adapt headings, links, captions, templates, and tables to actual mgwiki support.
Use no Markdown. Add relevant Malagasy category links (Sokajy) at the end of the
article, after all sections and appendices. Preserve category links already
present in the existing Malagasy article or sandbox: do not translate, rename,
remove, reorder, or duplicate them; keep their targets, labels, and sort keys.
Do not guess category targets or blindly import foreign-language categories.
Sandbox safety remains mandatory: new category links use [[:Sokajy:Name]], and
the only permitted change to an existing live category link is adding the
leading colon needed to make it inert. Already-inert links stay byte-for-byte
unchanged. Record category additions and any safety-only change in notes.wiki.
No live interwiki or Wikidata changes.
No unresolved translator comments, TODOs, or research notes in article text.

== 6. Editorial quality gate ==
Compare against complete pinned source and both existing texts. Evidence goes in
notes.wiki; set each review.json gate true only when actually checked:
* meaning: same claims, negations, qualifications, names, numbers, and dates.
* fluency: natural standard Malagasy; no untranslated prose except valid names,
  quotations, bibliographic material, or explained original terms. Check one
  space after Malagasy elision apostrophes (amin' ny, an' Andriamanitra,
  amin' izao) in new prose, not protected source text or wiki delimiters.
* coverage: all intended sections, tables, captions, and references accounted for.
* terminology: consistent sense-specific choices; no unresolved critical terms.
  Original foreign acronyms have Malagasy parenthetical translations; retained
  foreign terms/full agency names have correct italics and agency glosses.
  Book/movie/paper titles use MediaWiki italics without corrupting citation
  fields. Preserve original name order, with the verified Malagasy surname-first
  convention; never mechanically reverse Chinese/Japanese/Korean/Vietnamese names
  or guess the structure of a name. Record these checks in notes.wiki.
* citations: claims remain supported; references/identifiers neither invented nor
  lost; living-person and other sensitive claims receive extra review.
* links_templates: correct local targets, supported templates/parameters, usable
  files, new Sokajy links at the end, existing category links preserved (except
  the required inerting colon), no duplicate category additions, and no
  accidental categorization or interwiki side effects.
* neutrality: no promotion, unsupported synthesis, or changed evidential weight.
  Review all words-to-watch categories and Malagasy equivalents in context, not
  through a blacklist. Do not sanitize/rewrite source quotations, titles or
  citation metadata; preserve meaningful technical/legal qualifications.
* existing_preserved: sourced mainspace and sandbox contributions deliberately
  retained/merged; every removal explained. New pages explicitly mark this N/A
  in notes before setting the boolean true.
* wikitext_only: raw wikitext visually reviewed; no Markdown or output wrapper.

Run validate --draft …/draft.wiki. It is a conservative structural lint, not a
grammar/translation verifier or complete MediaWiki parser. Overlapping wiki/MD
list syntax is legal; do not reject ordinary MediaWiki lists.

== 7. Preview and proposal ==
Run prepare --job …. This verifies gates, checks all pinned live revisions,
renders through mgwiki Pywikibot action=parse, rejects visible parser errors and
category/interwiki side effects, and writes preview.html, proposal.json, and
changes.diff. Autonomously review raw wikitext and offline rendered text,
references, tables, image markup, and link metadata without fetching resources;
parser success alone does not prove factual or linguistic correctness.

Record destination, permanent source URL, changes.diff path, full proposal
SHA-256 digest, and substantive merge decisions locally. Do not pause for human
approval or send a progress message for every phase. Draft/evidence changes
require prepare again and fresh autonomous review. Digests bind exact bytes;
they are not evidence that a human inspected the article. /mgtranslate and user
translation/edit requests authorize this checked sandbox save, but explicit
draft-only/no-save instructions and harness-development tasks do not.

== 8. Guarded sandbox save ==
After successful autonomous review run publish --job …. No approval argument or
user prompt is required. An optional --approve DIGEST remains available for a
caller who wants to pin a particular digest, not as a mandatory human gate.
CLI verifies
proposal and artifact hashes, account Bot-Jagwar, target site/namespace/owner,
unchanged source/mainspace/sandbox, and exact draft bytes. Existing pages use
baserevid/basetimestamp and nocreate; new pages use createonly. Minor and bot
flags are off; cosmetic rewriting is disabled; attribution is in edit summary.

Any edit conflict, new/deleted target, source change, template-render change,
protection, authentication failure, or failed validation aborts. Refresh and
merge through a new init job, not by overriding guards. Never use force, skip
checks, or change the destination to bypass a failure. Rebase autonomously only
when unambiguous, at most once per task; repeated conflicts or material ambiguity
mean preserve work and stop without asking or refetching in a loop.

== 9. Verify and hand off ==
After saving, reread via Pywikibot and compare exact text hash. Store receipt.json
with target URL, revision, source attribution, digest, and confirmed status.
Report success only for confirmed read-back. A save may have reached the server
even if connection/read-back fails: receipt.json records an unconfirmed attempt
before saving. Do not blindly retry; inspect the page once through the paced
gateway and reconcile only if exact saved bytes and state can be established.
Otherwise record unconfirmed/blocked status and stop without questions.

Return a short Malagasy wikitext link to sandbox, or raw article wikitext if
requested. No Markdown, no claims that mainspace was updated. Preserve all local
evidence for later human review. Later revisions begin again from fresh snapshots.
